questions.question: Why does the ground on Mars look red?

options.text: Iron in the dirt that rusts

questions.because: The iron rusts, a bit like an old bike left in the rain.

questions.question: What is Perseverance?
questions.because: It looks for signs of ancient life and collects rocks to study.

questions.question: Long ago, rivers poured into Jezero Crater. What did they make?
questions.because: That was more than 3.5 billion years ago!

questions.question: What makes Earth's air glow in an aurora?

options.text: Tiny charged bits from the Sun

questions.because: They are called the solar wind. The green comes from oxygen.
questions.evidence: tiny charged bits from the sun

questions.question: How often does the space station go all the way around Earth?
questions.because: The crew sees 16 sunrises and 16 sunsets each day!

questions.question: What is Earth's air mostly made of?
questions.because: It also shields us from much of the harmful radiation from the Sun.
